title: Three crystalline solids
caption: Sodium chloride is an ionic lattice (6:6), copper a face-centred cubic metal in which each atom touches twelve others, and iron a body-centred cubic metal with eight neighbours.
alt: Three unit cells: sodium chloride, copper (face-centred cubic) and iron (body-centred cubic).
description: Sodium chloride: alternating Na⁺ and Cl⁻.
Copper: atoms at corners and face centres, coordination 12.
Iron: atoms at corners and the body centre, coordination 8.
